notes.title: Stealth and Horror games now go into Ninja mode when hit
notes.content: [p]They go invisible until they prepare their next hit.[/p][p]Aw, look how cute he is, with his hat and sword.[/p]

notes.title: New Enemy Abilities, and you can now freeze time!
notes.content: [p]- Games with a genre of Simulation now wear a Hardhat and are immune to keyboard attacks [/p][p]- Games with a genre of Strategy now wear a Military hat and are immune to mouse arrows [/p][p]- Fromsoft games now drop a Bonfire, you can heal over time by standing near it [/p][p]- Valve games carry a crowbar (but it doesn't do anything yet)[/p][p][b]- ALSO..... Introducing 'Nostalgia Trip Mode' [/b]If your power meter is at halfway, you can press Left Shift (or B / Circle for controllers) to freeze time, you can look at your enemies to see their stats (or play around with explosion particles) and stay in matrix mode until you attack.[/p][p][/p][p]Because why not? it's so damn cool. Best to time it with an explosion.[/p][p][/p][p]Other changes:[/p][p]- Increased powerup charge rate significantly  [/p][p]- Added voices for smaller enemies  [/p][p]- Added voices for when enemies are immune to damage [/p][p]- Disabled attack while you're dead so your corpse doesn't go crazy while it is Ragdolling [/p][p]- All explosion rubble is now removed as soon as you die, to help out lower end video cards.[/p]

notes.title: Cel Shading makes the game look much better!
notes.content: [p]Let me know if there's much of a performance loss for lower end video cards - you might need to lower the gfx quality in the menu.[/p][p][/p][p]I like the look, what do you guys think?[/p]

notes.title: Enemies are now significantly faster
notes.content: [list][*][p]added announcements on the loudspeaker from the commentary box every time you die and restart :)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]moved the Operating System 'Platforms' closer to the main spawn area[/p][/*][*][p]Added spawn locations behind[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Ragdoll impact rate[/p][/*][*][p]Increased size of all enemies a little[/p][/*][*][p]Страница магазина теперь переведена на русский язык. (Thanks to [b]Tan1f [/b]on the discord channel for the translation!)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New player model! No longer the fancy shoes hipster!
notes.content: [p]I've also added shadows, which makes it dramatically better. If you're taking a framerate cut from this change, try changing the gfx settings down a notch (or the resolution).[/p][p][/p][p]Another change is the head is now a cube, the sides change to the profile picture of the owner of the game list.[/p][p][/p][p]Really taking in all the feedback from the last few days, everything from now on is about polish and graphics overhaul. [/p][p][/p][p]A lot more to come over the next few weeks! The entire game might look different.[/p]

notes.title: Game Quest is in ANZ Indiefest 25!
notes.content: [p]Yay! the game gets momentum as soon as Silksong releases, who would have thought?[/p]

notes.title: Gained 1000 Wishlists overnight! Thankyou!
notes.content: [p]Last night wishlist count was 190, woke up to 1166![/p][p]My watch thought I was going for a run after seeing the number, thankyou so much for the support![/p]

notes.title: v0.2.1-Beta - Screenmodes (Borderless etc) and Directional Sounds
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Screenmodes (Fullscreen, Borderless, Windowed)[/p][/*][*][p]Directional audio setup on certain sounds (enemy ows, explosions, wing flapping)[/p][/*][*][p]Loading sound (enemy spawn) pitch now changes according to metacritic score (when above 80) to alert the player to a flying enemy spawns[/p][/*][*][p]Spectators can no longer be killed by normal attacks (as it was before)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.2-Beta Released - Combat Feel Overhaul
notes.content: [p]Playtest was always the same build as demo, but now that the beta it out, that will change.[/p][p]Playtest will have new experimental features, will most probably have bugs.[/p][p]Demo is the main stable production version, each update will probably have a bunch of lines in the changelog.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to try out the new stuff and don't mind if there's bugs, try the Playtest.[/p][p]Play the Demo if you want it (less) bug free.[/p][p][/p][p]Ok, here's the changelog for 0.2-beta:[/p][p][/p][p]- Expanded keyboard hitbox [/p][p]- Collision now includes entire animation length [/p][p]- Increased delay before attacking again (to reduce spam attacking) [/p][p]- Power attack now immediately raises keyboard, red glow is when power attack is activated [/p][p]- Added camera shake and red screen flash when taking damage [/p][p]- Moved collision mini-explosions to the front of the disk (increased radial force) [/p][p]- Boss insta-explodes when weakness is hit, again [/p][p]- UI fixes for ultra widescreen resolutions [/p][p]- Resolution list is now based on OS, not hardset [/p][p]- Fixed bug where sometimes you can't get out of the menu[/p][p]- Added flapping sounds to flying enemies (speed of animation is now tied to cost of game, to add variability) [/p][p]- All enemies now build up their attack (lean backwards) before attacking. Weak enemies do it so fast you don't notice.[/p]

notes.title: Native Controller Support!
notes.content: [p]Instead of just getting steam to auto map keyboard controls, there is now native support for controllers!  Which means shift will no longer lock on to enemies when playing KBM! Yay!  UI navigation also works with controllers (please report any bugs with this though!)[/p]

notes.title: Giant profile image monolith (changes when choosing friend's lists)
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a giant monolith in the sky, to show who is the god of the arena[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Improved Keyboard hits!
notes.content: [p]- Standard keyboard attacks now impact enemies more often (on-overlap instead of on-hit)[/p][p]- Changed player collision block radius with enemies, to prevent enemies from getting too close (under the keyboard)[/p]

notes.title: You can now play non-friend game lists! (if they allow it)
notes.content:
Game List section now has two tabs, Friends and Public
Added button to set your list to public (should be good for streamers)

notes.title: Added Attempts and Leaderboard per friend game list (and a bunch of other stuff)
notes.content:
- You can now see stats for each friend's game list before changing to their list

- Game query count (and check to see if list is public) is now stored in the player save, so you know which friend you checked when going through the list.

- Your most recent 5 attempts at a friend's list now shows up when checking friend info

- The top 3 players who finished a friend's game list the quickest will show at the top of the friend info

- Friends list is now searchable (has a search field at the top)

- Decreased the immortality time of enemies after hit (so you can hit them more often), increased default knockback when player hits enemies

- Various other bug fixes

notes.title: New Logo and Trailer!
notes.content:
I've revamped the assets a bit, adds a nice amount of polish.

I've also been working hard on fixing animation glitches and pesky pathfinding bugs, added more particle effects on collision - generally the game looks and feels a lot better, it's a great time to check it out.

notes.title: Added collision effects and enemy projectile trails - Various bug fixes
notes.content:
A Poison trail and explosion is now added to enemy projectile collisions
Rubble now comes off enemies in their colour when hit
Rubble on ground no longer gets enemies stuck (they can now move it around)
Logos now show in full colour, no dithering
Damage inflicted now shows up temporarily within enemy health bar

notes.title: Games now have logos!
notes.content: Pre-caches low res capsules to local disk, I'm playing around with material filters to make it look like it was printed from a dot matrix printer - subject to change.

notes.title: Fixed Attack Animations! For now anyway
notes.content: They're looking a bit more natural - you now need to wait until most of the animation is complete before attacking again.

notes.title: Added most of the sound effects (self recorded!)
notes.content:
Sound Effects for:
- When enemy games get damaged: 9 different 'ow's (with differing pitch according to damage/size)
- Mouse clicks
- Keyboard swings when attacking and blocking
- Acid sounds for gamer tear impacts (this one is not self recorded)
- Impact sounds of keyboard hitting disks
- Impact sounds of disks hitting skin (the player) and keyboard
- Keyboard block sounds

notes.title: Fixed bug where sometimes the games list was not downloading
notes.content:
If you encountered this issue, load the game up again and click retry.

If you loaded in the Developer Game List, you can attempt to download your game list by going to the menu by pressing escape, then clicking 'Go Back To My Games List'

Any further issues, please let me know!

notes.title: Free Beta Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
There's still a bit of polish needed before the early access release, but I'd love to get some feedback at this stage! So here's an early demo :)

Please let me know how it went in Discord or the Discussion Forums!

Thanks!
